sahneler.metin: The US Navy's giant airship Akron crashed into the Atlantic.
Seventy three of the seventy six men aboard died.
It had flown into a violent storm.
A downdraft pushed it lower and lower.
Its tail struck the water, and the structure broke up.
There were almost no life jackets aboard.
Most of the crew drowned in the cold sea.
The loss helped end the Navy's rigid airship programme.

aciklama:
USS Akron crashed into the Atlantic in a storm. The cause: severe storm downdraft and low flying altitude driving the tail into the sea.
